name: DOI.org
summary: Resolve a DOI to its handle record: the landing-page URL and other registered values, from the DOI Foundation's proxy server.
notes: Keyless. The answer is the raw handle record, not bibliographic metadata; pass type=URL for just the landing page.
responseCode in the body: 1 success, 100 handle not found (HTTP 404), 200 handle exists but no matching values (HTTP 200), 2 error (HTTP 500).

endpoints.name: Resolve a DOI
endpoints.summary: The values registered for a DOI (URL, admin and others), each with index, type, data, ttl and timestamp.

type.description: Only values of this type, e.g. URL; repeatable.

index.description: Only the value at this index; repeatable.

auth.description: Bypass the proxy cache and ask a primary handle server for the newest data.
